name: OmaDBngin
author: BlackCode
description: OmaDBngin: DBngin-style local database servers for the Omarchy bar. PostgreSQL, PostGIS, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, Valkey and MongoDB in any version, on any port, as the native engine or in Docker, started and stopped with a click

barWidget.description: Local database servers; click to create, start, stop, connect or remove them. Right-click for settings

schema.label: Running count
schema.description: How the bar icon shows the number of running servers. Replaces 1.6's label setting (Icon only = Hidden).

schema.label: Crash dot
schema.description: A red dot on the bar icon when a server stops on its own, until the panel is opened.

schema.label: Rows
schema.description: Detailed rows show uptime, CPU, memory and data size; compact rows show one status line.

schema.label: Stats while open
schema.description: Read CPU, memory and readiness while the panel is open. Off: no stats work at all.

schema.label: New servers run as
schema.description: Native downloads and runs the engine itself, like DBngin. Docker runs it in a container.

schema.label: Backup folder
schema.description: Where backups are written and listed. Empty: ~/Downloads.
